session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open Then Reversal Up'. Sell the bear trend from the open (4172) down to a streak of 25 consecutive bars without a bull body, climactic and unsustainable; break below the bear channel so profit taking soon at the 4108 low (08:45). Higher lows brought buying pressure from 09:00 through a mid-morning trading range (blue box), then a small pullback bull trend off a trendline break; breakout above the bull channel at 4138 was expected to fail, followed by a 50% pullback to the EMA (4128) and sideways-high day into the 13:00 close 4135. Footer 5/3.
